classification.difficultyReason: Infer missing lengths from equal-length marks and opposite-side totals, convert mixed units, and calculate composite perimeters.

content.prompt: Calculate the perimeter, using the method you prefer.

spec.description: Orthogonal staircase with five descending vertical boundary segments; matching double ticks on the top and left sides.
spec.mathematics: Left side is 10 cm and equals the top side. Total staircase horizontal and vertical travel each equals 10 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied 10 cm label and equality marks are visible.

answer.worked:
The top side is $10\text{ cm}$. The staircase's horizontal lengths total $10\text{ cm}$ and its vertical lengths total $10\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}P&=10+10+10+10\\P&=40\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: L-shape with top horizontal arm and downward right arm; matching double ticks on the inner horizontal and vertical.
spec.mathematics: Inner horizontal and vertical are each 30 mm; bottom is 15 mm; total height is 4 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions and equality marks are visible.

answer.worked:
$30\text{ mm}=3\text{ cm}$ and $15\text{ mm}=1.5\text{ cm}$. The inner vertical is $3\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Top length}&=3+1.5=4.5\text{ cm}\\\text{Left length}&=4-3=1\text{ cm}\\P&=4.5+4+1.5+3+3+1\\P&=17\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two rectangular notches in the upper boundary, with nine single equality ticks.
spec.mathematics: Five equal horizontal segments span 20 mm. Each of these and each of the four notch verticals is 4 mm. Outer height is 1.1 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 20 mm, 1.1 cm and all nine equality marks are visible.

answer.worked:
$1.1\text{ cm}=11\text{ mm}$. All nine marked segments are equal.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Marked length}&=20\div5=4\text{ mm}\\P&=20+11+11+9\times4\\P&=78\text{ mm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two downward triangular lobes joined at the central inward vertex, with a sloping top boundary.
spec.mathematics: The complete top boundary is 7 m. Its equal halves and the two inner diagonals share double ticks. The two outer edges share single ticks and are 3 m each.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied 7 m and 3 m dimensions and equality marks are visible.

answer.worked:
Each double-marked edge is half the $7\text{ m}$ top length. Both single-marked edges are $3\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Double-marked length}&=7\div2=3.5\text{ m}\\P&=4\times3.5+2\times3\\P&=20\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Orthogonal shape with a notch entering from the right; top extends farther right than the bottom.
spec.mathematics: Top is 10 cm, left height 9 cm, bottom 7 cm. Upper notch horizontal equals bottom. The three marked vertical segments are equal.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions and equality marks are visible.

answer.worked:
The upper notch edge is $7\text{ cm}$. The three marked vertical lengths total $9\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Marked vertical length}&=9\div3=3\text{ cm}\\\text{Lower notch length}&=7-(10-7)=4\text{ cm}\\P&=10+3+7+3+4+3+7+9\\P&=46\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Descending staircase with four single equality ticks and two double equality ticks.
spec.mathematics: Left height is 44 m. First two horizontals and first two drops are 12 m each. Last upper horizontal equals the 20 m right vertical.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied 12 m, 44 m and 20 m labels and equality marks are visible.

answer.worked:
The two short horizontal lengths are each $12\text{ m}$ and the longer horizontal is $20\text{ m}$. The downward vertical lengths total $44\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Bottom length}&=12+12+20=44\text{ m}\\P&=44+44+44+44\\P&=176\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
